note: DPP ablation (compliant/stubborn stand-ins, 30s budget). Verdict: the DPP is mixed in this benchmark (distinct destinations already give distinct score-cells, so diversity is free): it concentrates harder on public (helps) but slightly under-serves multi-route private (hurts). It is therefore shipped OFF by default (use_dpp=False); the default greedy fill is unchanged. The DPP is a correct, generalizable component for CONTENDED-cell settings.
